title: Pan-Seared Squid with Avocado Salsa
description: A gluten-free seafood dish featuring succulent squid with a refreshing avocado salsa.
instructions: Rinse the squid tubes and pat them dry.
Season the squid with salt and pepper.
Heat the Canadian Olive Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the squid to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the squid to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, combine the quenched Red Onion, ceviche marinade, and chopped cilantro.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the onion is translucent.
Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit.
Mash the avocado in a bowl and stir in the lime juice.
To assemble the dish, place the seared squid on a plate and top with the avocado salsa.
